concern_summary: This concern focuses on managing and updating a user's notification preferences for reports, allowing selection from various options and ensuring that changes reflect immediately and can be reverted.

This concern encompasses the retrieval and display of a user's notification preferences for reports, including visibility conditions and translations, enabling users to manage how they receive notifications.
This concern deals with setting default notification preferences for new participants invited to reports, ensuring they start with the appropriate notification settings.
This concern involves retrieving the notification preferences of child reports during actions, returning specific preferences or defaults based on user actions.
This concern relates to filtering reports based on their unread status and the user's notification preferences, ensuring only relevant reports are shown.
This concern encompasses all functionalities related to the display and interaction settings of the application's header and settings page, including visibility options and navigation.
This concern captures functionalities related to various policy-level settings such as foreign currency rates, distance rates, travel terms acceptance, and reconciliation account management.
This concern includes functionalities related to configuration management and settings validation, specifically for importing data and ensuring the integrity of provided configurations.
